mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL OR LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100, 2) END as growth_rate FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, COUNT(DISTINCT well_name) as cnt FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1 ) t

SELECT CASE WHEN prev_avg IS NULL OR prev_avg = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((curr_avg - prev_avg), 2) END as accuracy_lift FROM ( SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN confidence END) as curr_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN confidence END) as prev_avg FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND confidence IS NOT NULL ) t

SELECT CASE WHEN prev_time IS NULL OR prev_time = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((prev_time - curr_time) / prev_time) * 100, 2) END as time_saved_rate FROM ( SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, update_time) END) as curr_time, AVG(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, update_time) END) as prev_time FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) t
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT well_name) FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, create_time, update_time)) * 1000 FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT AVG(confidence) FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND confidence IS NOT NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY week_num) IS NULL OR LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY week_num) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((cnt - LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY week_num)) / LAG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY week_num)) * 100, 2) END as growth_rate FROM ( SELECT YEARWEEK(create_time) as week_num, COUNT(DISTINCT well_name) as cnt FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY YEARWEEK(create_time) ORDER BY week_num DESC LIMIT 1 ) t
SELECT DISTINCT dataset_name FROM log_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY dataset_name
